paragraphs.text: Face a villainous choice is a keyword action introduced in the Universes Beyond set Doctor Who . It is a punisher mechanic .

Villainous choice affects the player 's opponents . They are presented with a choice of two effects which are both detrimental. It is a punisher mechanic, but with targeting it has greater multiplayer appeal with negotiation.

Missy Legendary Creature — Time Lord Rogue Whenever another nonartifact creature dies, return it to the battlefield under your control face down and tapped. It is a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature At the beginning of your end step, each of your opponents faces a villainous choice — Each artifact creature you control deals 1 damage to that opponent, or you draw a card and chaos ensues. 4/5
